messages:
Marta (PM): Quick heads-up 1: we need one final pass on GA readiness for the predictor pipeline. Items: SLA wording, docs/runbooks, oncall coverage, monitoring alerts, pricing promo, and contract exceptions. Posting checklist in thread.

Eli (SRE): SLA draft: uptime SLA 99.9% monthly, latency p95 <= 120ms, p99 <= 400ms for typical contexts. Recommend explicit fallback policy: when queue_time > 200ms or cpu_util > 85% -> route to fallback-model-small. Also propose a 7-day elevated-response-window (SREs page faster) for week-1 GA.

Jess (Docs): API quickstart + examples done. Missing: troubleshooting section (prompt regressions, token accounting) and runbook steps for paging. I can finish troubleshooting + rollback snippets tomorrow morning.

Sanjay (Sales): Sales request: launch promo 10% off for first 60 days for up to 25 customers. Finance OK if we limit to named accounts and cap $ spend. Need product + finance approval and billing codes. I will own the promo roll-out doc and email template.

Dana (Product Ops): Monitoring items required before ship:
- metric: prompt_regression_rate by prompt-set
- metric: token_cost_per_request (daily/median/p90)
- metric: model_error_rate by version
- smoke test: end-to-end against canary on deploy
Also need alert definitions and escalation policy. Ops-bot can schedule smoke runs nightly.

Ops-bot: Nightly canary smoke scheduled 03:15 UTC. Results will post to #eng-sre and the rollout dashboard.

Carla (Legal): For Customer X HIPAA ask: we can accept SLA exception only via signed addendum + DPA. No standalone commitments in sales threads. Contract language must be reviewed by legal before commit.

Eli (SRE): Oncall plan: add +1 SRE to rotation for first 72 hours post-GA and a dedicated incident lead for week-1. Runbook excerpt: "If p99 > 400ms OR error_rate > 1% for 5 minutes -> 1) Pin traffic to stable model version; 2) Scale GPU pool; 3) If unresolved in 15m -> failover to fallback-model and page oncall."

Jess (Docs): Runbook PR: https://git.repo/PR/559 contains the full playbook and example rollback commands. Please add inline comments.

Eli (SRE): Debug smoke curl example:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"prompt":"healthcheck","max_tokens":4}'
```

Marta (PM): Who's owning the final gate checklist and publishing the "Ready to Ship" signal? Need single owner to close items.

Sanjay (Sales): I'll own pricing and customer comms (promo list & billing codes).

Eli (SRE): I'll own infra/SRE readiness (dashboards, runbooks, oncall rota, fallback config).

Jess (Docs): I'll own docs + runbook publishing and ensuring links in the playbook are live. ETA EOD tomorrow.

Dana (Product Ops): I'll own monitoring + smoke scheduling and the alert definitions doc.

Carla (Legal): I'll review any SLA exceptions and draft the addendum template.

Marta (PM): Great. I'll collate the checklist (links + owners) and mark GA when all owners confirm green. Adding a couple of small open items: 1) confirm reserved-pricing path for enterprise (Sales + Finance), 2) finalize the rollback command in PR #559, 3) confirm billing codes for promo. Please add any last-minute asks here. :rocket:
